description: Local reproducible snapshot for genuine public job postings. Do not copy full postings; store structured fields, concise public-posting excerpts, source metadata, and genuine application URLs only.

fields.title: Public job title
fields.location: Posting location when explicitly stated, otherwise null
fields.work_mode: Remote, Hybrid, On-site, or null if not explicitly stated
fields.min_experience: Numeric years when explicitly stated, otherwise null
fields.required_skills: List of explicitly required skills from the posting excerpt
fields.preferred_skills: List of explicitly preferred skills from the posting excerpt
fields.description: Concise public-posting description/requirements excerpt, not the full posting
fields.source: Source site or organization career page
fields.date_retrieved: YYYY-MM-DD date this snapshot record was collected
